name: Triduana

attributes.attribute: pulled out her eyes to avoid an unwanted suitor
possibly a local title of the triple goddess Brigit

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Triduana is a British goddess. In a story like one told of the Irish Brigit, she tore her eyes from her head. She did so to turn down an unwanted suitor. Brigit was a triple goddess, and the name Triduana holds the sense of three. So Triduana may be a local title of that triple goddess.

okr.objective: Record the minor British goddess Triduana.
